notes.title: Milo no Senki 1 - Update 1.2
notes.content:
Year 167, The Empire of Athermyl is overthrown by the Generalissimo Disgaries. In the embers of the coup, insurrections and old quarrels ignite once again. Milo, young baron with few coins to his name, traverses the continent to further a meager rebellion. From treason to alliance, from old ally to new ennemies, all seems terrible for the small band of no-names, will you lead them to victory?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/dc735fc35d020530dd0b7d8e6840a3ac96e91469.png

Dive down in the Great Athermylian Civil War in this new Free Expansion! The remake of the original Milo no Senki will let you experience the events that propulsed Milo into the fray of a continent in disarray.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/1ad439b5676a476de19999fc18e944f4ec90efb4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/d11f7b5a9ec942b172cc8fcea24b0f23453b985a.png

Soundtrack

To spice up this update, the game comes with a new soundtrack by the briming with talent Ogan (@ogan.inc, youtube)!

How to access it?

To launch your adventure, it suffices to click on the Milo no Senki 3 logo in the main menu to switch to Milo no Senki 1 (and reciprocally). Warning, I did not include a tutorial in the remake, so if you want an introduction to the fundamentals you can play the first four chapters of the third opus or open the encyclopedia.

Update Notes

Expansion

20 new chapters
5 new music tracks by Ogan
around 6-7 hours of adventure
13 new achievements

Feature

New icon for unit capable of healing

Bug

various bugfixes

notes.title: At the beginning of Milo...
notes.content:
All the great adventures have their source in small tales...

8 years ago, Milo embarked in the tumultuous Athermylian Civil War, and to celebrate this anniversary, you will soon meet again the old band of fugitives in their old legend told anew!

Coming soon to Steam, the first opus, originally published to Scratch, comes back with true maps (not some plain chessboard), entirely rewritten dialogues, an original soundtrack, and a fresh coat of paint for a fresh cost of nil! Milo no Senki will be a free extension for all owner of Milo no Senki 3.

A Flavour

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/70cc7e69e98e2d14e30c7898e2da10842036aea3.png

Lead your good-living companions to triumph against the tyran Disgaries, plunging ever deeper into the civil war.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/9eda459e0e0fa9b7e571bbca574d69244d01d220.png

Confront the champions of your time and forge the legend of Milo in the Empire's iron.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43659123/5a7bc2f8378eefc2c40cdfa8324c2306831e0897.png

Survive the torment of the numerous vultures hungry for the continent in disarray.

Why Milo no Senki?
In 2015, I was making my first games on Scratch, and as a strategy game enthusiast, it was obvious I needed one to my belt. That is how in two weeks, the first Milo no Senki came to be. A RPG of a few tools, collaged with images from the web and music from other games, wrapped into a facetious satire of Fire Emblem. And while we're at writing a story held together by two strings, well it would be best to put friends in their so that they can live a unique and idiotic adventure.

Milo no Senki is still to this day a project for which I have a lot of affection, be it through its simplicity, or its ability to weave real-world characters into comical and singualr situations. By remaking this game, it is the occasion for me to revisit those first steps in the serie, and put forward everything that makes it fun, humorous and ludic. Even though it is not necessary to tell the first Milo no Senki to tell the third (given its elusive world), it is a story that may interest you and is worth playing.

I hope you will have a lot of fun playing through the adventures of Milo in the past, present, and future!

notes.title: Discover the universe of Milo no Senki 3 : Content and Future
notes.content:
Athermyl, the Thugs speak much of it, the common mortal people far less. It's in this land that Lord Milo rules peacefully over his little Barony, when in 167 after the Empire's founding, the young Athermylian emperor is savagely murdered by the vile Disgaries in a bloody coup...

So began the adventures of Milo, in which he met a number of singular companions such as Patrick the Wise Elder,  Jeremy the Salmon's Cavalryman, Vincent the Vincent, and Quentin the Thug. All this merry band of misfits tasked to save the continent against the Athermyl Empire, Avalon, Embresia, ... And I'm already forgetting Nelson the Prince of the neighbouring kingdom of Isialys, who died in all this mess, with some grim tales of impersonation, though, if you believe me, it's more of the author's lack of direction.

And so, in the nearing year 200, Milo hit the road again in this new opus where for the script's and public needs, he will go to save Nelson from Hell, also coloquially known as the Kingdom of the Dead. All this and more in Milo no Senki 3, which is the third (surprising) opus of a serie which started in 2015 on Scratch, and which now takes place right between your hands!

In production since November 2022 by Tâm Nguyên and Léonard Vaney!

What to expect on 6th March 2023?


 Twenty hours of content
 Twenty playable characters and almost a hundred of adversaries
 A game of Neither-yes-nor-No
 Twenty types of units to master on the battlefields
 At least one Nelson to save, possibly with a halo
 Twenty music tracks by Tâm Nguyên, Ogan & Arthur Valentin
 Less than twenty bugs, or we hope so

But what is Milo no Senki 3?

On the continent of Athermyl, ravaged by war and disease- Okay no, this we already covered, so, Milo no Senki 3 is a turn-based tactical RPG in which you must bring Milo and his companions to victory through Hell. Similarly to chess, but where each player would move all their pieces in their turn, Milo no Senki 3 invites you to use every character and their unique role to confront the opponent's army. With his streamlined system, this game was designed as  an introduction to the genre of tactical turn-based games, but as Hell all that matter lies in its depths, and thus suits novice and grandmasters alike!

The future of tomorrow when going forward

If you are dying to play more of Milo no Senki 3, stay put for...


 Bonus chapters
 The first Milo no Senki, included in its integrality
